sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant, is taken on record.
Heard Sri Sunil Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamma Ram, learned AGA for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 726 of 2022, under Sections 411, 413, 414, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC and 3/5/25 Arms Act, Police Station Kotwali, District Ballia, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and four others and according to the FIR,
applicant and four others were apprehended and from their possession, one stolen motorcycle each were recovered and it is further alleged that they were using the motorcycle by changing their number plate and chassis number etc.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and in fact, nothing incriminating has been recovered from his possession and on the basis of false recovery of motorcycle, applicant has been roped in the present matter alongwith other co-accused persons.

He further submitted that applicant is having criminal history of thirteen casesand only due to this Satish Saini vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49732803/
1 reason, police implicated him in the present matter.

sentences.text: He further submitted that applicant is in jail in the present matter since 30.12.2022 and criminal history of the applicant has been explained in para-4 to the affidavit and all the offences are triable by Magistrate Ist class, therefore, he may be released on bail.
Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the arguments on fact advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of the record, it appears that applicant and four others were apprehended and from the possession of the applicant and others, one stolen motorcycle each were recovered.
Although, applicant is having criminal history of thirteen cases but his criminal history has been explained in para-4 to the supplementary affidavit and all the offences are triable by Magistrate Ist class and applicant is in jail since December, 2022.
Therefore, from the discussions made above, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Satish Saini, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 Ankita  Satish Saini vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49732803/
